description: Add a photo place whose photos take turns by themselves, with one dot per photo, to a new-website site: a component, one script of the site's own (so a strict Content-Security-Policy holds), its texts in English and German, and tests/hero-carousel.spec.ts. Settings: pause "button" (default, a visible Pause / Resume button) or "dots" (no button, a dot stops it); swap "instant" (default) or "fade". Built to keep the page from jumping, the dots readable on any photo, and phones usable. Run on request, for a home page or any page. Trigger phrases: "photos that rotate", "auto-rotating hero", "carousel", "slider", "key visual that changes", "dots under the photo", "slideshow", "Bildwechsel", "Karussell". Not for one photo (no carousel needed), a gallery the visitor pages through, or video.
